the topic-oriented approach can help user quickly find interesting topics, and the topic-oriented navigation is useful for mining related multimedia data.

the following issues: (1) How to construct topic-oriented multimedia dataset and visualize it on mobile devices; (2) How to provide a topic-oriented navigation to mobile device user for quick access to the intended clips; (3) How to mine related clips by using the automatically constructed relationships between topics; (4) How to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed solution.

this paper proposes a novel approach to organize multimedia dataset and visualize it in a topic-oriented and map format.
our solution is a promising approach for multimedia data organization and visualization on mobile devices.
the proposed solution is feasible, effective and efficient.

a novel solution is proposed to help mobile user to consume multimedia data on the move.

a novel solution has been proposed to organize and visualize multimedia items on mobile devices, which can help mobile users to quickly find out their interested items in a topic-oriented and graphic-rich manner.
the topic-oriented navigation and visualization can help mobile user quickly locate and retrieve intended multimedia data, and further help them mining related multimedia data.

it provides an intuitive and effective solution to mobile users consuming multimedia clips.
